description: Takes one photo off one of the person's listings: a wrong, blurry or doubled one, or one that doesn't match the description. photo_id is the photo's id (ph_...) or its address, as get_listing's card or see_listing_photos gives it. Check with the person first. If the listing was up, it goes back to a draft for them to sign again. The card's photo strip has a remove button for each photo too. Needs sign-in.

photo_id.description: The photo's id (ph_...) or its address.

name: remove_listing_photo
title: Remove a photo from a listing
